selection: Seven additional, distinct public open issues; source blobs and task-specific criteria were checked before their model calls.

acceptance: Distinguish the original HeaderDataMailHelper timestamp exception from the current date-parsing path; do not assume they are the same implementation.
Consider the reported unusual RFC date and missing or unparseable dates without asserting the frequency of archive-wide failures.
Propose local deterministic date-header cases covering the report, invalid input and an ordinary timezone-aware date; no live archive claim.
Compare the originally reported JPEG buffer heuristic with the current formula and explain the dependency on image content, dimensions and quality.
Distinguish an undersized buffer and missing JPEG end marker from an established universal bound or a verified hardware fault.
Propose buffer-size and end-marker controls and state that actual sensor behavior remains untested.
Trace this.selector use in ajaxForm delegation and ready-state handling under versions of jQuery where that property was removed.
Distinguish the maintainer’s proposed 4.x selector option and later 5.x requirement from functionality already present in the pinned source.
Propose a two-unrelated-form regression and a nondelegated control; do not submit real forms.
Trace the reset utility into database initialization and distinguish the reported embedded-MariaDB wait from SQLite behavior.
Separate the report and proposed connection approach from a proven root cause, including the already-running service case.
Propose local mocked connect/start and prompt tests for supported database modes without changing real credentials.
Trace the draft GGUF mount source and destination in the pinned transport code and compare them with the reported nonexistent host path.
Distinguish a later report of a partial fix from proof that every draft-model scenario works.
Propose local mount-argument controls for draft and primary models without invoking a real container or downloading weights.
Trace upload event prop updates separately from the externally supplied disabled property in the pinned component.
Distinguish the original report from the later headless-browser report that a recent version stayed disabled; do not assume the report proves this revision.
Propose a local callback round-trip regression with disabled and enabled controls; identify browser execution as unverified.
Trace how history entries are ordered and converted into adjacent map segments in the pinned source.
Account for the reported phantom segment from the oldest point and the later proposed PR without treating either as a confirmed root cause.
Propose a multi-point chronological history test with line and opacity controls; do not claim a physical-device reproduction.

limits: Current source and historical issue discussion may describe different revisions.
These are source investigations, not executable fixes or physical-device tests.
